values.note: 70 drive-in sites in three loops (51 electric), all back-in gravel pads; ReserveMN lists them at 30-70 ft, so every one takes a 23-ft rig. A separate 14-site cart-in loop is tent-only.

sites.source: DNR park record spk00121 ('71 drive-in sites across three campground loops', 'The max RV Length is 50 feet', 'Gravel pads are available for RV campers', '14 cart-in sites suitable for small tents') + ReserveMN facility 814 (19 Drive-In at 30-56 ft, 51 Drive-In Electric at 35-70 ft, 14 Cart-In; site details 'Back-in'), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: DNR park record spk00121 ('The campground has 51 electric sites, with 30 and 50amp hook ups') + ReserveMN facility 814 site details ('Amp' '20, 30, 50'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Showers, flush toilets, campground water and the dump station are seasonal (water back on about May 7, 2027); vault toilets year-round; campground Wi-Fi April 1 to October 20.

facilities.source: DNR park record spk00121 (sanitation: showers and flush toilets 'available seasonally in the main campground', vault toilets 'available year-round', dump station 'available seasonally'; 'WiFi is available in the campground from April 1 to Oct 20'; 'Anticipated water on is May 7, 2027'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Open all year, but the roads may not be plowed in heavy snow; no advance reservation is needed late fall to early spring, but campers register through the reservation system on arrival when the office is closed.

season.source: DNR park record spk00121 ('The campgrounds are open year round but may not be plowed when heavy snow persists.'; 'No advanced camping reservations are needed in late fall, winter or early spring, but campers must use the reservation system to register on the day of arrival if the park office is not open.') + ReserveMN facility 814 in season 2026-11-11 to 2026-12-01, read 2026-11-11

note: Blue Mounds State Park campground near Luverne, in a wooded bottom beside the Mound Creek reservoir below the park's quartzite cliffs and bison prairie. --Claude
summary: DNR park record and ReserveMN read: 70 drive-in back-in sites (51 electric, 30/50 amp; stored 30 -> 50), 30-70 ft so all fit, DNR 50-ft limit, open year-round (unplowed in heavy snow), seasonal showers/flush/dump, Wi-Fi Apr-Oct. Stored count 87 (incl. cart-in) -> 70. Fees left ($24/$34, matching ReserveMN June 2027). Not waterfront kept; old evidence understated how close sites 11-13 are.
